headline: FosRich Pursues Real Estate Sale as Liquidity Squeeze Halves Revenue
summary: Jamaica Stock Exchange-listed FosRich is pursuing the sale-and-leaseback of real estate assets as a prolonged liquidity squeeze reduced nine-month revenue by 47.7% to $1.26 billion.
why: Liquidity constraints force specialty distributors to monetize physical assets to sustain operations and manage inventory purchases.

impacts.name: FosRich
impacts.why: Slumping revenues and liquidity pressures force asset monetization strategies.
